# M7-S3: comptime generics cross packages through facts (T-Sec6, T-205).
# Package wire exports the comptime generics Autowire and Names; package
# main instantiates them over a local type and over a wire type. The
# expansion copies live in main, built from the comptime source text in
# wire's __.LOGOS member. A wire type's unexported field stays out of the
# expansion (#65): writing it from main would not compile.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^wire-ok$'
stdout '^names-cfg \[Port\]$'
stdout '^names-svc \[Port Host hidden\]$'
stdout '^cfg-port 9090$'
stdout '^labels-cfg \[0=Port\]$'
stdout '^labels-svc \[0=Port 1=Host 2=hidden\]$'
# A const if over comptime.IsStruct in an exported comptime generic: the
# record folds the package constant to a literal, keeps the predicate,
# and each importer expansion keeps the live branch.
stdout '^describe-svc struct$'
stdout '^describe-cfg struct$'
stdout '^describe-int scalar$'
stdout '^describe-off silent$'
# A package whose only use of wire is a type argument of a comptime
# generic compiles: the import survives erasure of the const for range.
logos run ./names
stdout '^\[Port\]$'
cd ..

# The exported comptime generics travel as marked source text in the
# __.LOGOS member of the wire archive: the type parameter and the names of
# the defining package are markers the importer resolves.
go list -export -deps -f '{{if .Export}}packagefile {{.ImportPath}}={{.Export}}{{end}}' fmt
cp stdout $WORK/importcfg
go tool compile -p example.com/wiretest/wire -importcfg $WORK/importcfg -o $WORK/wire.a w/wire/wire.lgo
go tool pack p $WORK/wire.a __.LOGOS
stdout 'comptime Autowire'
stdout 'comptime Names'
stdout 'comptime Describe'
stdout 'const if true && '
stdout '_logos_ctpkg\.Container'
stdout '_logos_ctpkg\.Resolve\[f\.Type\]'
stdout '_logos_tparam0'
stdout '//logosimp fmt fmt'
stdout '_logos_ctimp0\.Sprintf'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/wiretest

go 1.27

-- w/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Container struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

type Config struct {
	Port   int
	secret int
}

func Resolve[T any](c *Container) T {
	var zero T
	switch any(zero).(type) {
	case int:
		return any(c.Port).(T)
	case string:
		return any(c.Host).(T)
	default:
		panic("unresolvable")
	}
}

func Autowire[T any](c *Container) *T {
	var v T
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		v.[f] = Resolve[f.Type](c)
	}
	return &v
}

func Labels[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for i, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%d=%s", i, f.Name))
	}
	return out
}

func Names[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

const traced = true

const quiet = false

func Describe[T any]() string {
	const if traced && comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else const if traced {
		return "scalar"
	}
	return "silent"
}

func DescribeOff[T any]() string {
	const if quiet && comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else const if quiet {
		return "scalar"
	}
	return "silent"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/wiretest/wire"
	"fmt"
)

type Service struct {
	Port   int
	Host   string
	hidden int
}

func main() {
	c := &wire.Container{Port: 9090, Host: "svc"}
	s := wire.Autowire[Service](c)
	if s.Port != 9090 || s.Host != "svc" {
		fmt.Println("BAD", s.Port, s.Host)
		return
	}
	cfg := wire.Autowire[wire.Config](c)
	fmt.Println("wire-ok")
	fmt.Println("names-cfg", wire.Names[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("names-svc", wire.Names[Service]())
	fmt.Println("cfg-port", cfg.Port)
	fmt.Println("labels-cfg", wire.Labels[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("labels-svc", wire.Labels[Service]())
	fmt.Println("describe-svc", wire.Describe[Service]())
	fmt.Println("describe-cfg", wire.Describe[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("describe-int", wire.Describe[int]())
	fmt.Println("describe-off", wire.DescribeOff[Service]())
}

-- w/names/names.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/wiretest/wire"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(wire.Names[wire.Config]())
}
